subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live in scoped Control UI settings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or both?
rationale: Current docs retire persisted WebChat config while the existing nearby UI preference path is scoped browser settings; choosing the owner determines the compatible implementation shape for the linked PR.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Add the preference to the existing scoped Control UI settings path and keep WebChat gateway config retired unless a separate operator need is approved.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Introduce a documented config surface despite the current retired WebChat config stance, with compatibility and doctor expectations handled explicitly.

options.title: Support Both Surfaces
options.body: Allow an operator default plus a browser-local override, accepting a larger precedence and documentation burden.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Add the preference to the existing scoped Control UI settings path and keep WebChat gateway config retired unless a separate operator need is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the open implementation candidate and are already carrying the exact preference design through review.
